versions.changelog:
Initial release of PassGen: a secure, fully local password & key generator.

- Generate strong passwords, passphrases, URL-safe tokens/API keys, UUIDs, and numeric PINs using Python’s standard library (no third-party dependencies required).
- Includes password/passphrase strength checker; all operations are offline, strictly local, and do not read/write/upload any files.
- Supports customizable options for output length, format, and quantity across all generators.
- Results print to terminal only — never saved or transmitted.
